turns.question: Of the partner outreach messages we sent from 1 to 3 October 2026, what share got an answer within 12 hours?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for replies within 12 hours (it records no reply-time window); the closest metrics are reply rate (any reply, at any time), messages replied and messages sent, and for messages sent 1 to 3 October 2026 the reply rate is 0.667 (66.7 %, 4 of 6 messages replied), which is not a 12-hour figure. Late: partner_outreach.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
